svg.aria-label: What I build with, as an exploded assembly drawing of a composite robot: a tracked chassis, motors and ESCs, servos, a 6-DoF arm, a Jetson Orin, a Raspberry Pi 5, an ESP32, an Arduino, a camera, a 3D LiDAR, an IMU and GNSS, with ROS 2 and Nav2, OpenCV, MediaPipe, PX4 and Betaflight, in C, C++ and Python.

g.text: Not one robot: the parts I keep reaching
